entries.source: I manage the Year of the Witch Shop, where you can exchange ingredients from the event for rewards.
Or, come and talk to me again to view the Year of the Witch Shop!
Talk to Alcina nearby if you'd like to learn how to gather ingredients, as well as what they're used for!
Bring ingredients to me and you can make special stews, which you can consume to gain permanent stat buffs and other rewards.
During this year, we make an assortment of mystical stews for the townsfolk to enjoy.
Each type of mob will drop its own ingredient. For example,  Undead mobs will sometimes drop a Festering Fly!
Happy Year of the Witch!
Here, take a look at what's brewing in this year's Witches Stew!
However, we need your help with gathering the various ingredients needed for each stew.
One Mayfly Stew coming right up!
To get ingredients, you need to kill certain types of mobs found throughout SkyBlock.
Your Mayfly Stew is ready!
And getting to them would take ages, even if you had a Travel Scroll?
Before you go, let me show you how to add a contact.
Sounds amazing, right?
Then why don't ya buy one? I'll do a little discount, just for you.
Why don't you try it out on me now?
✆ It's really as simple as that. I'll add myself to your Contacts now!
✆ Nice job!
✆ That's it. Enjoy your purchase!
✆ To see who you can add, simply open up your phone and check the Contacts Directory.
Come to me if you want some Potion Effects to help you in your journey!
Good Luck!!
I can give you better effects depending on your Bingo Level.
I gave you potions recently! Give me some time to prepare new ones!
I'm here to help you with Bingo!
Splash...
Splish...
Sploosh!
Why not buy some social items for your island?
You seem like quite the social butterfly!
Hey hey hey again! I'll trade you some copper for some carrots!
Hey hey hey!
I'll trade your Jacob's Tickets for farming tools!
I'll trade your Jacob's Tickets for useful items!
Oh, darn it :(
Yay, thank you so much!
✆ Hi dear!
✆ I only share my contact with those who are on Jacob's contact list.
✆ If I need any farming done back home, I'll be sure to call ya!
✆ Oh and also, you need to have earned a GOLD medal in his contest if you want to be on MY list!
✆ Sweet!
For a price, you can buy it here!
The Furniture Shop has many different kinds of cool furniture for you to put in your world!
That sac over there is my son.
Fuel makes your Minion work harder for a limited time.
I have one in my Minion, look!
If you place your Minions poorly, they will complain!
Minions always have 4 Upgrade Slots where you can place Fuel or other items.
My favorite Minion Upgrade is the Compactor, soooo useful!
Once you unlock a Minion, you also unlock all their Level up recipes!
Open their Menu and look for their Perfect Layout!
People always empty the storage of my Minion when I'm not looking!
Sorry, but that's mine!
There are multiple types of Fuel, like Coal, Enchanted Bread, and many more!
At the end of each year I bake cakes for everyone in town to celebrate the year.
I made one especially for you, here you go.
Wondering where to store your cakes? You can buy a New Year Cake Bag from me. Click me again to open my shop!
Hello there!
Storing them in your Bank keeps them safe and allows you to earn interest at the start of every season!
You may want to store your Coins in a safe place while you are off adventuring.
You will regret this.
Ah! You look like someone strong.
Could you give me a hand? If you help clear out some of these monsters, I'll pay you for it!
For now, here's a reward for helping me out!
Here, take this sword. It should help you take out the Zombies.
I recommend you gear up in the Combat Settlement. You should talk to Rosetta, she has some great armor for sale!
If you're up for the challenge, both the Graveyard and the Spider's Den beyond it are great training grounds for improving your Combat Skill.
These are trying times, indeed. The Graveyard up ahead is overflowing with monsters! Anyone who comes in is spooked off by the grunts of Zombies in the distance.
Hello! Do you have a pet?
Personally, I prefer the bee pet!
Pets are little companions for your adventures in SkyBlock!
The reward is not in my chest!
I've dedicated my life to collecting all the information I can about this place.
Keep your eye out for anyone with ⚑ GUIDE above their head. They tend to have useful information!
Not everything in this world is immediately obvious.
You can use /guides to view all of the guides you've learned about.
At the end of the event, your Bingo profile will be deleted.
But don't fret, all of the Bingo Points you earn during the event will stick around!
Complete personal tasks and work towards Community Goals to earn Bingo Points.
Good luck this week. And remember...haaaaave fun with it!
You can spend these points in the Bingo Shop on any profile!
You have 7 days to complete as many tasks as you can on a fresh, temporary profile!
Go into the Mine to collect Coal, then come back to learn how to reforge items!
However, this time I will reforge any item for the low price of Coal x10!
Reforging usually costs Coins, but since I'm feeling friendly I can reforge your first item for Coal x10.
Stay safe, recruit!
If you build, they will come!
Are ya ready to play now?
Good luck, pal!
Howdy there, partner!
I give ya a fancy lil' dart stick, you shoot sum Zombies!
I won't keep ya, then.
Stop wasting my time then, will ya?
Them rules are quite easy to get the hang of.
There'll also be sum Redstone Lamps aroun' the arena that can be shot fer points when they light up!
Well, gosh darn it!
Wouldja like to play Zombie Shootout?
Ye'll get more score based on what armor the Zombie's wearin'.
A swashbucklin' shame, if ye ask me...
Ahoy there, matey!
Good luck, matey!
Here's yer shovel, then.
The rules are as follows - I give ye a shovel, ye dig up the sand on the lookout fer fruit!
There's a bunch o' different fruits, each with differin' point values and abilities.
Whenever ye be ready, I'll be waitin'.
With that said, are ye ready to play?
Would ye like to do some Fruit Digging?
Ye can RIGHT CLICK with yer shovel to swap between dowsing modes, which give ye a little info every time ye dig!
Yer supposed to use that info to avoid them bombs and pick the best blocks to mine.
Ah, hello there! I have some information for you, but you need to finish talking to Sam first!
Check out the Furniture Shop downstairs!
Don't worry, I got you covered!
Here you go! Don't misplace it this time. It would've done just the same in my home.
Here you go! Hopefully, you'll make better use of it than I ever could.
Hey, I noticed you haven't used that blueprint I gave to you. Did you lose it?
Hey, how are you doing with the Greenhouse? That blueprint was complex.
Looks like you could use some help with your Greenhouse.
Luckily for you, I made a copy!
No worries, I'll come back later.
No worries, I'll hang on to it for now. I'll come back later.
Talk to me any time to see your Greenhouse mutation progression.
Thank you! I'll be checking in to see how you're doing with the Greenhouse.
The Furniture Shop is downstairs. Purchase cool furniture down there!
*cough* happy hunting! *cough*
*cough* woosh *cough*
Alright. I'll see what I can do.
Don't ask me how I got this okay?
Hmmm...
I can't give you my strongest potions because my strongest potions are only for the strongest beings and you are of the weakest...
I solemnly swear I am up to no good.
Oh? A custom order ey?
Ok, here you go. Don't go spending it all in one place.
Pro tip: use /centauri
These items are born of the old magic. You have no idea of their power.
Ugh fine. Here you go.
Cheers! Here, take these trousers for payment!
Do that, and then we can talk!
Howdy! Yer a friend of Lumber Jack, are ya?
I don't see 64 Birch Logs. Where are they?
I need 64 Birch Logs. Could you grab 'em for me?
I wanted Kelly to get some Spruce Logs for us today, but I've not seen her in a while... Can you maybe look for her in the Spruce Woods?
Me and my mates each gather a specific type of wood, and then split it all evenly so we can all increase our different collections!
So much wood to chop, such little time...
The Park is home to many different kinds of wood. Each kind has its own collection.
Well, works for me!
You heard about that weird Cult over in the Dark Thicket? I’m considerin' joining them.
I can show you some of the best islands I've ever visited!
I like to visit people's private islands with my hot air balloon.
The world is filled with incredibly talented people!
Candidates that were either elected as Mayor or Minister the previous Election sit out the following Election and only have a single perk when they return.
Do you want to hear more about that?
Each Mayor also has a ✯ Minister Perk, which goes hand-in-hand with the Minister system!
Each Mayor has a perk marked as a "✯ Minister Perk".
Every few months, a Special Mayor enters the running.
If you say so.
Is there anything I can help you with?
Once a Mayor is elected, the runner-up with the most votes is selected to act as their Minister.
That Minister will provide its ✯ Minister Perk as a nice little bonus!
The mayor elections are currently closed but come back later and check them out!
Their perks are much stronger and crazier!
They'll usually have somewhere from 1-3, with an 8% chance to receive a 4th if they already have 3.
They're always sure to shake things up.
Was there anything else you wanted to know about?
Well, most of the Mayors have a total of 4 perks to choose from, the amount they have at once varying.
You can also vote in the mayor elections by heading through the warp to the left!
I'm not welcome in the warren anymore.
It's not about the individual leaps; it's about how we hop together as a team.
By the time you're at 75 Cold, you'll be moving at a snail's pace...
Every 25 Cold, your speed cap will be reduced by 25%.
I've figured out exactly how this Cold stuff works!
If you want to keep moving, keep warm!
In order to better understand the cold, sometimes you have to get warm.
We're chill, you and I.
For a price, you can have it all!
I've seen it all - every island from here to the edge of the world!
Over the years I've acquired a variety of Talismans.
I'm sorry, Bingo profiles do not qualify for the Museum.
Welcome! The museum is just starting to take shape. Your first few contributions are the seeds of something magnificent!
Come back when you're Museum Milestone 10.
Did you not listen to me?
Yet you come back to me and presume that you are.
See ya next time!
You seem new here. You should probably try to get some Enchanted Wheat for me.
Dusk is disappointed. Dusk goes away now.
Dusk needs some watermelon to quench his thirst. Dusk would appreciate it.
Dusk thanks you. Dusk will make sure to visit your farm again.
Most mobs have a chance to spawn as Runic, so keep your eye out!
Runes are cosmetic effects that drop from Runic mobs!
You can also combine two runes for a chance to create a higher level rune with a better effect!
You can apply runes to weapons and armor with the Rune Pedestal behind me.
Anyways, I've been writing down every enchantment I've come across so far. Here, take a look!
Most enchantments require you to be a certain Enchanting Level to use them, though.
There are many, many, many enchantments that exist in SkyBlock.
The reward is in my chest!
Back to standing still for hours on end!
I'm hungry...whatcha got?
Ooh, this is exactly what I wanted!
Before that, I used to compete in sugar cane contests.
Cultivating sugar cane gets boring eventually.
I've been living on this island for 10 years.
I've competed in numerous sugar cane contests, but I've never actually tried farming other crops.
I've now retired to this house to live out the rest of my days.
This'll be a nice hobby to work on. Thank you.
A farmer's life is a simple life.
Great day to be on the Farm!
Collect 1 of each crop in The Barn to add to your Farming Collection!
Collect leather, chicken, and pork to add to your Farming Collection!
Collect wheat, carrots, potatoes, pumpkins, and melon to add to your Collection and unlock cool rewards!
Craft a Wheat Minion!
Did you craft a Wheat Minion yet? Here's the recipe!
Did you know that chickens drop eggs and cows can be milked?
Exactly what I needed. I think I will take the remainder of the day off.
Feel free to harvest any crops on the island, I'm taking a break.
From there, find your Chicken Pet and left-click to summon it!
Great! Now go to the SkyBlock Menu and and open up your Pets Menu.
Have you been to the Mushroom Desert?
Hold your Chicken Pet in your hand and right-click to put it in your Pets Menu!
I took a break from work for too long! Now I need your help to meet my quota!
In order to summon your Chicken Pet, you'll need to add it to your Pets Menu first.
Take this Chicken Pet, it'll help you gather more crops!
That Chicken Pet gives you Farming Fortune, which gives you a chance to drop additional crops!
That Chicken Pet gives you ☘ Farming Fortune, which gives you a chance to drop additional crops!
The entrance to the Mushroom Desert sits atop a hill to the north.
The farm animals here provide a variety of resources.
There you'll find resources only an experienced farmer can handle - cocoa beans, sugar cane, mushrooms, and cactus!
Those Fairy Souls scare off the animals.
Try collecting some of the various crops on the island.
Welcome to The Barn!
While Minions are great, the best way to gather resources is by hand.
You can find many more types of crops there!
You condemn me to doing my own work? How can you do this to me!
May your destiny be ridded with fortune.
Mortal, the time of reckoning is near. The Past will light the future.
Soon.
Check the calendar, there should be another feast scheduled!
That might've been our best feast yet!
We're hoping to run another one next Early Autumn!
Maybe next time.
Until next time!
You won't be able to store any items in the Garden, you should keep them on your Private Island!
Nothing to see here.
We went to school for this!
We're managing money!
My job here is to make sure the lava flows and that the titanium shines.
These forges have been running at an endermite's pace!
Yep, it's mostly watching other people work!
Have you found the Epic Giraffe yet?
Hey there, I'm George the Pet Collector!
I travel the world searching far and wide for the rarest pets I can find!
If you have any pets which need a new home I'd be happy to buy them off you!
Enid and I are thrilled that our two children love it as much as we do!
Fishing is the family business.
He saved my skin then, and I'm forever grateful to him.
I prefer the open water. More peaceful, less Ghasts!
I've only gone lava fishing a few times in my life.
Here, you can join me in drinking away your sorrows.
Oh...wait. Nevermind.
GET BACK HERE!
THEY'RE STEALING THE CRYSTAL! GET THEM!
You do not belong here! Get out while you still can!
... I've realized... those ladders... are just... too much...
... care to... buy one...?
... not built... for sloths... you see...
Climbing... so exhausting...
I spent... years... crafting... this magical scroll...
With it... you can... skip the climb... effortlessly...
It's a great day to go for a run!
You're always welcome to try the race again. Just run over the pressure plate to begin!
They are both lying, the reward is in my chest!
Do you know what they would've done if they found me?
Oh, thank goodness! They sent someone to get me out of here.
Are you in the market for a Husbandry Axe?
They'll help you gather drops from animals faster!
Click me again to open the Iron Forger Shop!
For my wares, you'll have to pay the iron price!
I've recently got into cooking, yesterday I made pasta carbonara, today I'm planning on baking a carrot cake.
Seriously though, I accept Coins.
Seriously though, I only accept Coins.
Will have to order some food today then.
Did you know that you gain additional ☘ Farming Fortune while on the Garden? You can check it in your SkyBlock Profile!
Did you know that you gain additional ☘ Farming Fortune while on the The Garden? You can check it in your SkyBlock Profile!
I'll come by later.
Thanks for the crops. See ya around.
Check ye calendar eh? Or better yet, click me to learn more, eh!
Come see me in the Hub to claim your reward!
Come see me in the hub anyway!
Gosh darn it matey, can't believe ya do me like that, eh?
Hot diggity, that's a lot of medals! I gave ya some rewards, speak with me if you're interested in the rest.
Howdy
Howdy!
Howdy! Fine barn ye got there eh? Good lad, you think ye could get me some wheat, eh?
Howdy! Fine day eh?
I organize farming contests once every few days!
Keep it up!
Let me count the final results eh?
Let me count the results eh?
My contest has started!
Thanks a lot matey. That'll help ye prepare my next farming contest eh?
The Farming Contest is over!
Uh oh! Couldn't figure out how well ya did!
Well, well! I coordinate a farming contest every few SkyBlock days, eh?
You wouldn't happen to be one mighty farmer eh?
You wouldn't happen to be one mighty fine farmer eh?
✆ Hope to see ya farming!
✆ Howdy!
✆ I simply enjoy a more simple life, ye?
✆ I'm far from stupid, don't get me wrong, eh.
✆ Ma' always told me to worry of stuff I don't understand.
✆ Ya sure can add my contact, against 10 Jacob's Ticket, eh?
✆ Ya won't call me too often, eh?
An investment in knowledge pays the best interest.
Empty pockets never held anyone back. Only empty heads and empty hearts can do that.
If you live for having it all, what you have is never enough.
The real measure of your wealth is how much you'd be worth if you lost all your coins.
If you can prove to me you're a real archer I'll forge you arrows whenever you need them.
Ready to test your skills? Step on the pressure plate and all the targets will light up, if you can shoot them all in 25 seconds, I'll know you're the real deal.
And if you come accross duplicates of the same Chip, don't worry, you'll be able to upgrade them to EPIC and LEGENDARY rarity, boosting their maximum level and effectiveness even further!
And if you come across duplicates of the same Chip, don't worry, you'll be able to upgrade them to EPIC and LEGENDARY rarity, boosting their maximum level and effectiveness even further!
But here's the catch - once it hits Level 15, you'll need to upgrade it before it can keep growing. Same goes for Level 30.
Chips can be found all over the place, and once you unlock them, you can start upgrading them.
Every crop you harvest gives your tool experience, leveling it up over time.
Farming using one of these tools also gives you Sowdust, which will be essential in upgrading your Chips!
Have you picked up a Specialized Farming Tool yet?
Here, take this, your first Chip. Go ahead and use the chip to unlock it.
Hey there! My name's Jeff...
Nice! I've added the Chip Menu to your SkyBlock Menu while you are on the Garden, so you'll have easier access to them from now on.
Oh, and you might have noticed something new, Sowdust. You'll start earning it just by using your tool from now on.
Once you get your hands on one, swing by and see me and I'll teach you about Chips!
Show me a Specialized Farming Tool and I'll teach you about Chips!
These Specialized Farming Tools are a game changer! You can level them and upgrade to become even more powerful.
These don't just sit pretty, they grow stronger the more you use 'em!
This stuff is important because it lets you upgrade Chips, which will give you permanent buffs.
Well, well! You got yourself a real Farming Tool, huh?
You can have as many Chips as you want, just keep upgrading them with Sowdust!
You can now have as many Chips as you want, just keep upgrading them with Sowdust!
You should hear what Sam has to say first before talking to me!
Cocoa Beans only grow on one type of tree!
Did you know Slimes can spawn near the void?
I don't talk to guests! Go away!
I refuse to speak with guests!
I seem to be having some issues warping you... Check again soon!
I've heard that scary monsters can attack your island sometime in Autumn.
In my opinion, Magma Cubes are just fiery slimes.
It's the holiday season in SkyBlock and that can only mean one thing...
Jerry unhappy.
Jerry's Workshop is under attack!
Jerry.
Jerry...
Leave me alone, guest!
My expertise doesn't come for free!
Off you go! Thanks for the help!
Pigmen are great at hoarding wealth.
Progress as far as you can by killing mobs, gaining collection, and using minions.
Rabbits can spawn in different biomes!
Save the Jerrys' home and ensure all of SkyBlock gets to receive Gifts!
Shiny creatures can drop shiny things!
Thank you for your bravery! Good luck!
The SkyBlock universe is full of islands to explore and resources to discover!
The only way to obtain Emeralds is to trade for them!
There is no escape...you are stranded!
This is not my realm. I must return. Thank you.
This place desperately needs more Iron Golems!
Use the Portal to warp to the first of those islands - the SkyBlock Hub!
Villagers tend to have cool trades!
Villagers tend to have sweet trades!
Wait, how did I get here? [2/2]
You are truly a hero! Thank you for helping us!
Your SkyBlock island is all you have!
Your SkyBlock island is part of a much larger universe.
Your SkyBlock island is part of a much larger universe... [1/2]
Could you find my dear Romero?
He wears glasses and blends well in a crowd!
He's in a cave somewhere under the Savanna Woodland.
Nice to meet you!
Oh!
Between you and me, if you ever want to upgrade it you should travel to the Crimson Isle.
A bouquet? For me? How sweet!
A flower? For me? How sweet!
Hey there, I'm Kat the Pet Sitter!
I might even be able to give them new abilities!
If you have any other pets you'd like to upgrade, you know where to find me!
Oh, hey!
Stop by once it's done, okay?
While you're busy adventuring I can take care of your pets.
✆ Aww, you shouldn't have! :3
✆ But hold on, I don't give my contact for everyone.
✆ Do you want me to train your pet?
✆ Friends? Sure!
✆ Hello?
Excellent! You have returned the Scavenged Diamond Axe to its rightful place!
Excellent! You have returned the Scavenged Emerald Hammer to its rightful place!
Excellent! You have returned the Scavenged Golden Hammer to its rightful place!
Excellent! You have returned the Scavenged Lapis Sword to its rightful place!
Talk to me when you have found a Scavenged Diamond Axe!
Talk to me when you have found a Scavenged Emerald Hammer!
Talk to me when you have found a Scavenged Golden Hammer!
Talk to me when you have found a Scavenged Lapis Sword!
Hmm, too bad.
Sadly you can't gather logs in the The Garden, however there are plenty of crops here!
Greetings! I've been running low on paper recently for my Enchanted Books, could you bring me some Sugar Cane?
Greetings! Welcome to the Library!
I'll be sure to make some Enchanted Books out of these, I hope you come around some day!
The Library is your one-stop shop for all things enchanting. Enchant items, purchase Enchanted Books, and more!
Use the Enchantment Table to enchant an item!
Very unfortunate, I really needed that paper...
You can enchant items by clicking any Enchantment Table. Enchanting costs experience levels - the more levels you spend, the better enchantments you will receive.
Sorry, but there's... not much to see here right now.
Try dropping by another time!
Ah you found my Dragon Shortbow!
Ah, do you need help finding the remaining pieces?
Ahh, this one is a bit tricky.
Alright, not bad, not bad!
Anyways, I'm hurt and I lost my bow in the chaos.
Are there other pieces you need info on?
Are you strong enough though?
Are you sure you don't want that sword?
Ask me anything regarding Dragons!
Awesome, wear all the pieces and show me!
But the truth is, I really like it here.
Come see me later and I'll tell you all about them!
Do you recognize me? I changed my armor!
Drop by his shop a little later and I'm sure he will sell you one for cheap!
Exhausted? me? No no no.
For the longest time I thought I would move to the Crimson Isle or visit the Catacombs after this place.
Half of them are dropped by the Endermen on this layer, the other pieces are a little harder to obtain.
Happy dealing with you, I hope this sword will help you as much as it helped me.
Have you found the full Ender Armor Set and Equipment yet?
He doesn't usually sell them but he's my friend.
I got the bow from the Pearl Dealer up there near the entrance of the island.
I have an extremely strong emotional attachment to this item so...
I knew I saw one of those Seers grab it for themselves.
I think you are making a mistake, perhaps the biggest mistake of your life!
I use a Void Sword, it's a very powerful weapon.
I'll let him know you helped me!
I'm just about to go slay some Dragons.
I'm just taking a break.
I'm sure one of them will have my Dragon Shortbow.
I'm sure you'll figure it out.
If you mine enough Ender Nodes you'll eventually find the Gauntlet.
If you take down enough of those you'll end up getting the Cloak.
If you want a piece of advice, you should start by killing the Endermen up here.
It gets stronger with each piece of Ender Armor you are wearing.
It took me a while to get that strong.
It's from those Endermen up there, where we first met.
It's just from regular Endermen, like the rest of the armor!
My time here is over, I think I'll go down in the Dragon's Nest very soon.
Okay. If you need help, I'll be here.
Really?
See you around!
Thank you so much, I owe you one.
That was crazy, I'm still shaking!
That's incredible, that took me at least a week!
The Dragon teleported behind me and hit me with a claw attack!
The End is a creepy place, but you get used to it!
The fight was going smoothly and just as I was about to land the finishing blow, BAM!
They sometimes drop important gear like the armor I'm wearing.
This one isn't too bad.
What I enjoyed the most was helping you and I want to stay here to help more people.
What do you say?
Which piece are you struggling to find?
Woah, you're wearing the full Ender Set!
Would you mind defeating some of them for me?
You already made a ton of progress and I'm excited for the future.
You don't sound very excited...
You haven't got this one yet?
You see those Seers inside the Dragon's Nest?
You see those purple End Stone or Obsidian that sometimes appear around here?
You wouldn't believe what just happened, I was fighting one of those Dragons...
⚑ Dragon Guide is my new vocation.
Buy a few items from Sirius and come back!
He regularly runs events at a nearby house, but only under the cover of night.
It's a... business, auctioning sweet items.
My cousin Sirius leads an... organization.
Not too loud!
Psst! Listen here!
As you do this, you'll unlock various crafts and useful stat boosts that will help in other areas of your adventure.
Cheers! Let me tell ya a little about what we're going to be doing.
Have you enchanted your axe with Efficiency V? It'll help ya break stuff a lot faster.
Have you spoken to my mate Charlie over in The Park yet? He could probably use your help.
Here, let me unlock the Foraging skill for you, and then you can get started!
If you feel like Foraging is the thing for you, continue down the path and head towards The Park.
It's far less painful than using your fists to punch trees, I'll tell ya that much!
My friend Charlie can be found there. I'm sure he'll have some work for you!
My woodcutting assistant has fallen quite ill! Do you think you could take over for him?
Nice job! In return for those logs, I'll give ya this Promising Axe.
Timber!
To get you started, please bring me 20 Oak Logs! You can break the trees just off the trail to get 'em.
Use your fists for now - I'll give you my previous assistant's axe if you can prove your worth!
We will be Foraging! As one of SkyBlock's core skills, Foraging involves cutting down lots of different types of trees!
Buy and sell Wooden Axes with me!
My chest has the reward!
Do you thirst for adventure?
Do you wish to slay the mightiest beasts of the land?
One of the others is lying!
You did NOT just do that!
Before spraying on a wall, consider previewing it in the menu! Right-click on any spray of your choice and it'll magically appear in your hand.
Come back with the right amount of items!
Don't forget to refill your spray can with dye! You can pick some of the flowers in my garden if you want to.
For now, enjoy the sprays you have available in your Spray Can!
Hey there!
I love sprays! So many colors!
I'm a world-famous artist to be. Most people just call me "the new da Vinci".
In my garden are some flowers. Could you pick 5 Poppies and turn them into Rose Red Dye, then bring them back to me?
In the distant future I'll let you create your very own sprays with this canvas...
In the future, the canvas room will let you save your drawings to sprays!
Let me know when you're done with your painting!
